hero.subtitle: Private speech-to-text for your Mac with system-wide dictation, file transcription, prompts, profiles, history, dictionary, and snippets.
hero.platformNotice: Windows Beta and iOS Alpha are available for early testing.
features.title: The macOS 1.0 core.
features.subtitle: The stable release focuses on dictation, transcription, prompts, profiles, history, dictionary, and snippets.
features.private.title: Private by default.
features.private.description: Run speech-to-text locally on your Mac with no telemetry, no subscriptions, and no mandatory cloud dependency.
features.dictation.title: System-wide dictation.
features.dictation.description: Use a global hotkey to dictate into any app, with fast insertion and configurable behavior.
features.prompts.title: Prompts and automation.
features.prompts.description: Process text with built-in prompt actions, then go deeper with the local API, CLI, and plugins as advanced surfaces.
features.profiles.title: Profiles, history, dictionary.
features.profiles.description: Keep app-aware settings, searchable history, correction rules, and snippets in one place.
features.transcription.title: File transcription.
features.transcription.description: Drop in audio or video files, batch transcribe them, and export subtitles with timestamps.
howItWorks.title: See it in action.
howItWorks.caption: Press a hotkey. Speak. Text appears.
howItWorks.videoFallback: Your browser does not support the video tag.
engineComparison.title: Choose your engine
engineComparison.subtitle.mac: Six speech engines - three built-in, more via add-ons.
engineComparison.subtitle.other: Two speech recognition engines. All run entirely on-device.
engineComparison.cloudHint: Additional engines (Qwen3 ASR, Groq Whisper, OpenAI Whisper) are available as
engineComparison.mac.engine1.name: WhisperKit
engineComparison.mac.engine1.description: Apple-optimized Whisper models. Best for multilingual use and streaming preview.
engineComparison.mac.engine2.name: Parakeet TDT v3
engineComparison.mac.engine2.description: NVIDIA's latest TDT architecture. Extremely fast transcription for European languages with excellent accuracy.
engineComparison.mac.engine3.name: Apple SpeechAnalyzer
engineComparison.mac.engine3.description: Apple's native speech recognition. No manual model downloads - models are managed by macOS. Requires macOS 26+.
engineComparison.win.engine1.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B
engineComparison.win.engine1.description: NVIDIA's TDT architecture optimized for ONNX Runtime. Fast transcription for European languages, CPU-only.
engineComparison.win.engine2.name: Canary 180M Flash
engineComparison.win.engine2.description: Compact multilingual model with built-in translation. Supports EN, DE, FR, and ES.
engineComparison.ios.engine1.name: WhisperKit
engineComparison.ios.engine1.description: Apple-optimized Whisper models. Best for multilingual use and streaming preview.
engineComparison.ios.engine2.name: Apple Speech
engineComparison.ios.engine2.description: Apple's native speech recognition. No model downloads needed - fast and reliable.

appleDictation.files.title: Audio and video files

appleDictation.history.title: History and automation
appleDictation.history.description: Searchable transcription history and a local HTTP API for workflows.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Use the right support path for the platform and release stage you are on. macOS 1.0 is the stable release; Windows Beta and iOS Alpha are feedback-heavy preview builds.
support.mac.title: macOS 1.0
support.mac.description: Stable release support for installation issues, permissions, dictation, file transcription, prompts, profiles, history, dictionary, snippets, and bundled integrations.
support.win.title: Windows Beta
support.win.description: Expect to report bugs, edge cases, and rough UI behavior. Beta feedback is valuable, but some instability is normal at this stage.
support.ios.title: iOS Alpha
support.ios.description: The iOS build is still experimental. Missing features and frequent changes are expected while the mobile product is taking shape.
support.beforeReport.title: Before you report a bug
support.beforeReport.item1: Include the app version and your OS version.
support.beforeReport.item2: Describe exactly what you expected and what happened instead.
support.beforeReport.item3: List the active engine, model, prompt, or profile if relevant.
support.beforeReport.item4: For macOS, attach the JSON diagnostics export from the Error Log when possible.
support.community.title: Community channels
support.community.description: For setup questions, workflow ideas, and quick checks, the community Discord is usually the fastest path.
releaseStatus.title: Release Status
releaseStatus.subtitle: TypeWhisper ships on multiple platforms, but they are not all at the same maturity level. This page is the reference for what is stable today.
releaseStatus.mac.detail: This is the official stable path for daily use, documentation, support, and launch messaging.
releaseStatus.win.intro: Windows is currently a public beta.
releaseStatus.win.detail: Core workflows are available, but quality, polish, and compatibility are still being tightened before a stable release.
releaseStatus.ios.intro: iOS is currently an alpha preview.
releaseStatus.ios.detail: The mobile experience is still experimental and should be treated as early access rather than a broad release.
releaseStatus.mac.title: macOS 1.0
releaseStatus.mac.description: Stable direct-download release with the officially supported core workflow.
releaseStatus.win.title: Windows Beta
releaseStatus.win.description: Public testing build for early adopters who want to try the Windows app and report issues.
releaseStatus.ios.title: iOS Alpha
releaseStatus.ios.description: Experimental TestFlight build for very early mobile testing and feedback.
